title: Six terms unlock the scorecard

name: text-117
text: Click-through rate. The share of impressions that produced a link click.
textPreview: Click-through rate. The share of impressions that produced a link click.

name: text-120
text: Cost per 1,000 impressions. A standard measure of media delivery cost.
textPreview: Cost per 1,000 impressions. A standard measure of media delivery cost.

name: text-123
text: A movement to the next desired step: click, conversation, order, or delivery.
textPreview: A movement to the next desired step: click, conversation, order, or delivery.

name: text-126
text: Average order value. Delivered revenue divided by delivered orders.
textPreview: Average order value. Delivered revenue divided by delivered orders.

name: text-129
text: Return on ad spend. Observed net revenue divided by advertising spend.
textPreview: Return on ad spend. Observed net revenue divided by advertising spend.

name: text-132
text: Ghosted, cancelled, refunded, or adversarial conversation outcome.
textPreview: Ghosted, cancelled, refunded, or adversarial conversation outcome.

text: The word conversion is context dependent. Always name the denominator and the next step. ROAS is not profit because cost of goods, fulfilment, payment fees, and overhead are missing. AOV measures order size, not customer profitability.

text: Campaign type changes the success question. An awareness campaign should not be judged as though its primary purpose were immediate revenue. The YAML lookup supplies one primary KPI, supporting diagnostics, guardrails, allocation metric, and analysis guidance.

text: Weights are useful only when the business approves the trade-offs. For the POC, src_2 makes the primary objective explicit, uses supporting KPIs to explain it, and lets guardrails restrict a decision. This is easier to audit and teach.

title: Target status follows explicit gates

text: There is no LLM in this path. Limited evidence can produce achieved with concerns even when the primary KPI passes. Missing outcome maturity produces data not ready. Every classification can be reconstructed from component results and reason codes.

text: Scale requires the allocation metric and critical guardrails to pass with ready evidence. Limited evidence deliberately downgrades a potential scale to keep as test. Positive spend with zero delivered orders becomes do not fund.
